mxCell.value: Restaurant Rush | Stage 3 | Turn 7 | 1/4 — Arrival and Happy Hour

Preconditions: currentTurn = 7; this turn has not started; table 1 is free; Happy Hour has not been used. Player selects Happy Hour = Yes. Private controller helpers are expanded into their relevant calls below.
«create» VIPCustomer(3)
New customer: id = 3, status = WAITING, satisfaction = 100, order = null. Arrival is processed before Happy Hour bonuses.
State: customer3 is WAITING with satisfaction = 100 (capped). All three controllable staff have acted = false. Happy Hour is active on turns 7 and 8.

Restaurant Rush | Stage 3 | Turn 7 | 2/4 — Host seats customer 3

Continuation of page 1: the same objects continue; headers here do not create new instances. Player selects Host → seat customer 3 at table 1. Success path: Host is available, customer is WAITING, table is free.
seatCustomer(3, 1, StaffRole.HOST)
seatCustomer(customer3, table1)
Host inherits seatCustomer(...) from SeatingStaff and markActed() from ControllableStaff. These calls execute on the host object.
State: table1.occupant = customer3; customer3.status = SEATED; customer3 is removed from the waiting queue; host.acted = true.

Restaurant Rush | Stage 3 | Turn 7 | 3/4 — Waiter takes the discounted order
Continuation of page 2. Player selects Waiter → take customer 3's order. Customer 3 chooses menu index (3 − 1) % 6 = 2: Pasta, base price = 1800 cents, preparation requirement = 2 units.
VIP calculation: (1800 × 9 + 5) / 10 = 1620 cents. Controller then applies Happy Hour: (1620 × 8 + 5) / 10 = 1296 cents (integer division).
«create» Order(pasta, 1296)
takeOrder(customer3, order3)
State: customer3.order = order3; order3 is PLACED with 0/2 units; finalPriceCents = 1296 ($12.96); waiter.acted = true. Customer remains SEATED.

diagram.name: 4 - First preparation unit and end of turn

mxCell.value: Restaurant Rush | Stage 3 | Turn 7 | 4/4 — First preparation unit and end of turn

Continuation of page 3. Player selects Chef → prepare customer 3's order. Chef is available. The controller first requires the Waiter to have acted. The order needs two preparation units; only one can be completed this turn.

endTurn() processes: payments → EATING customers → JUST_SERVED customers → satisfaction / abandonment → advanceTurn(). Customer 3 is SEATED, so only satisfaction / abandonment applies to this customer. Other customers are outside this trace.
End of Turn 7: currentTurn = 8; Happy Hour has 1 turn remaining; customer3 = SEATED, satisfaction = 95; order3 = PREPARING (1/2); table1 occupied; chef.acted = true.
